description: One election or survey in the connected account: schedule, ballot, voters, ballots cast, turnout and quorum, and links. For a DRAFT election it also reports what still blocks publishing and the exact price the publish step would charge, and who pays it (free, plan, prepaid balance, or card at the finish link). Per-question results are on the election page link; this tool reports counts only.

election.description: The election's id or slug, from list_elections or create_election_draft.

name: get_election
title: Status of one election or survey
